experiment_metadata.purpose: EVIDENCE ONLY: characterise whether a purely SINGLE-STEP post-action safety check can MISS delayed hydraulic deterioration emerging over the sustained horizon as tank states evolve. Contrast single-step vs trajectory-aware; sweep look-ahead horizons. No mechanism/policy/horizon selected, ranked, or scored.
experiment_metadata.prohibitions: no mechanism/policy/horizon selection; no ranking/scoring; no production wrapper; no reward.py; no PPO

metric_definitions.p_min_psi: min over 121 service nodes of PDA service pressure at instant t
metric_definitions.D_psi_nodesum: Sum_i max(0, 20 - p_i(t)) over service nodes (psi*node)
metric_definitions.N_neg: count of service nodes with p_i(t) < 0
metric_definitions.N_20_descriptive: count of service nodes with p_i(t) < 20 (DESCRIPTIVE, not a safety oracle)
metric_definitions.DSR: demand-satisfaction ratio Q_served/Q_req (PDA) at instant t
metric_definitions.Q_unserved_gpm: max(0, Q_req - Q_served) at instant t (gpm)
metric_definitions.p_min_horizon_psi: min_t p_min(t) over the look-ahead horizon
metric_definitions.t_pmin: argmin_t p_min(t): report index and hours of the worst-node minimum
metric_definitions.D_cum_psi_nodesum_hours: Sum_t D(t)*dt, dt = report step = 0.5 h (rectangular)
metric_definitions.tank_level_ft: m_to_ft(head_m(t) - tank elevation_m): water depth above bottom
metric_definitions.realized_pump_speed: reported pump setting when status is Open, else 0 (closed)
metric_definitions.native_rule_event: a pump STATUS transition per report instant, coincident-with tank levels

TS1.note: inherits the chronic-baseline ill-posedness at theta_p above ~4.16 psi

TS2.type: relative worst-node degradation vs aligned baseline trajectory

TS3.type: relative aggregate-deficit increase vs aligned baseline trajectory

TS4.type: negative-pressure hard backstop over the look-ahead horizon
TS4.note: only well-posed HARD absolute gate on this chronically sub-20 network

horizons_tested.note: 1 control step = one 30-min report instant; 'full' = 96 h horizon. Horizons are CHARACTERISED, not selected.

baseline_trajectory.interpretation: pre-existing baseline deficiency: chronic sub-20 psi at the worst node is present WITHOUT any agent action; this is distinct from control-induced deterioration.

reissued_sustained.description: static command HELD for the full 96 h horizon = command re-issued at every 30-min control interval (the realistic env case; pump speed re-issued each control step).

applied_once_characterization.note: a genuine single-application-then-revert run would require adding non-native time-based controls to the frozen instrument (changing the native control count); NOT simulated here. The near-term indices approximate the one-interval effect; the pump realized-speed trajectory shows whether native rules override a non-reissued command.

computational_cost.note: EPANET is deterministic; a look-ahead adds no stochasticity. Linear per-step split is an approximation, not a per-step benchmark.

PPO_compatibility.note: PPO is model-free: the env need not be differentiable. A clip/reject guard makes executed != commanded, so the train/execute gap must be observable to the policy. Latency is wall-clock, not learning-theoretic.

limitations: Finite look-ahead is NOT a long-term / infinite-horizon safety guarantee: a horizon of H control steps only certifies behaviour within that window.
Detection capability != safety guarantee: a trajectory-aware rule may DETECT delayed deterioration without any mechanism yet being selected to ENFORCE a bound.

Applied-once (single-application then revert) is NOT separately simulated: it would require adding non-native time-based controls to the frozen instrument (changing the native control count). The re-issued/sustained case IS measured; the applied-once case is characterised via the near-term trajectory and the pump realized-speed evolution.

Coverage: only reference (baseline), the single severe corner (prv_lower_pump_lower), and one intermediate corner (prv_all_lower) are measured over the horizon. Interior points, mixed corners, and the joint (action x uncertain-demand) space are NOT covered.
No validated safe/unsafe oracle: single-step non-activation vs delayed deterioration is reported descriptively; NO false-positive/false-negative/accuracy is computed.
Provisional thresholds (theta_p, eps_p, eps_D) are swept to expose behaviour, NOT tuned or selected; horizons {1,2,4,8,full} are characterised, NOT selected.
Q_leak uses an uncalibrated emitter coefficient (relative use only).
